title: Introduce token sparsity index and trace-alignment dashboard
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: We observe intermittent cost/latency spikes driven by invocation payloads that exhibit highly sparse token usage patterns (e.g., long prompts with many inert tokens or templates). Current token-level cost metrics miss structural sparsity signals that correlate with kernel occupancy and prefetch inefficiencies. This PR introduces a lightweight token_sparsity_index telemetry metric, an invocation-level token_alignment_score for trace correlation, a dashboard that surfaces cross-stage alignment heatmaps, and an alert multiplier that increases alert sensitivity for cohorts with high sparsity entropy. Scope: instrumentation changes in the runtime telemetry pipeline, exporter mappings, a new dashboard JSON, updated alerting rules, unit and integration tests, and a short runbook describing troubleshooting steps and an automated synthetic replay to validate alert behavior. Checklist: 1) Add token_sparsity_index and token_alignment_score to telemetry schema and exporter mapping. 2) Compute per-invocation sparse-token histogram and export as sparse_bucket label. 3) Add dashboard panels: sparsity distribution, crossstage alignment heatmap, kernel-occupancy correlation scatter, and cohorted alert history. 4) Add alert rule with adaptive multiplier based on cohort sparsity entropy and safety cap to avoid alert storms. 5) Feature flag telemetry.feature.token_sparsity to gate rollout. 6) Add unit tests for metric computation and CI replay test. 7) Add runbook and example query snippets to docs. Commits summary: - Add metric computation and unit tests (aisha/telemetry/sparsity) - Wire exporter label mappings and feature flag (aisha/telemetry/exporter) - Dashboard and alerting rules (aisha/observability/dashboards) - Runbook and synthetic replay harness (aisha/observability/runbooks) Changed areas: telemetry/schema.go (new metrics, label enums), telemetry/sparsity_calculator.go (core computation), exporters/prometheus_mapper.go (label mapping), observability/dashboards/token_sparsity.json (new dashboard), alerts/token_sparsity.rules.yml (new alert), docs/observability/token-sparsity.md (runbook), tests/telemetry/sparsity_test.go, integration/synthetic_replay/sparsity_replay.go. Review conversation highlights: Marco Velasquez: "Nice signal, but compute cost on hot path? Please ensure sparsity index is O(n) and bounded memory." Author: "Implemented streaming histogram with bounded buckets, added tests to assert memory usage remains constant for long sequences." Emily Zhang: "Alert multiplier looks promising but could amplify noise for low-volume tenants." Author: "Added entropy-based floor and a per-tenant minimum sample window; also feature-flagged rollout so we can A/B for selected tenants." Jonas Müller: "Please add a dashboard panel that ties kernel occupancy percentiles to sparsity buckets." Author: "Added kernel-occupancy correlation scatter and a percentile rollup panel." CI summary: initial run failed due to a flaky integration test in synthetic replay (timeout). Fixed by increasing replay timeout and adding retry logic. Subsequent CI run passed all unit, lint, and integration checks. Deployed behind feature flag and rolled out to 10% of traffic for internal tenants for two days; collected telemetry and validated alert sensitivity without increased false positives. Merge outcome: merged via squash into main after approvals from Marco and Emily. Release notes: "Add token sparsity telemetry and token alignment dashboard. New alert rule to surface sparsity-driven cost/latency regressions. Rollout behind feature flag. See docs/observability/token-sparsity.md for runbook and mitigation steps." Runbook excerpt: "When an alert fires, open the token_sparsity dashboard, filter for the tenant and time window, inspect cross-stage alignment heatmap for mismatched prefixes, run the synthetic replay harness to reproduce, and if confirmed reduce model sequence length or enable prefix warmup cache for the affected route." Testing and validation: unit tests assert correctness over synthetic token shapes including all-uniform, interleaved sparse patterns, and pathological long-template cases. Integration replay generated 5k synthetic invocations across 3 sparsity cohorts and validated that alert multiplier increased sensitivity by 2x for high-entropy cohorts while keeping baseline false positive rate <1%. Backwards compatibility: telemetry schema additions are additive and exported label names are prefixed with sparse_ to avoid collisions. Rollout plan: enable feature flag for internal tenants -> monitor false positive rate and CPU overhead -> gradually expand to 50% -> full rollout after 2 weeks if metrics stable. Notes: I intentionally kept the runtime changes minimal and added comprehensive tests and a defensive feature flag. This PR is observability-first: it provides signal, tooling, and actionable runbook to debug sparsity-related cost anomalies.
